exposure.needed: whether an operator runs the flux CLI update flow at a time when a release candidate is the latest available version

original.statement: The Flux 2.7.0 CLI now skips release candidate versions when updating (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5507).

decision.reason: [ev-0f1afb29729f] is a single CLI changelog line saying release candidates are now skipped on updates. It does not name a flag, values key, resource or version range, so no static predicate can show which environments are exposed. Exposure depends on whether an operator runs the CLI update flow at a time when a release candidate is the newest version, which is runtime state. An undecidable exposure with a runtime-behavior-gap reason is therefore the honest condition, though what 'updates' covers is not detailed in the evidence.
